props.title: Subprocessors
props.description: Third-party services that process data on our behalf.

props.content:
Last Updated: March 2026

When you use our website or services, we engage certain third-party subprocessors to help us operate our business. This page lists the subprocessors we use, the purpose of each, and where you can learn more about their data practices.

We select subprocessors that meet our standards for security and privacy. We enter into data processing agreements where required and require subprocessors to protect your information in accordance with applicable law.

We may update this list from time to time. If we add new subprocessors that materially affect how we process your data, we will update this page and, where appropriate, notify you through our Privacy Policy or other means.

Subprocessor List

Subprocessor Purpose Location Privacy / Security
Cloudflare Content delivery network (CDN), DDoS protection, and web application security Global (United States) Privacy Policy
DigitalOcean Cloud hosting infrastructure for our website and client projects; serverless functions United States (multiple regions) Privacy Policy
Google Analytics Website traffic analysis and usage analytics Global (United States) Privacy Policy
Hotjar Website behavior analytics, heatmaps, and session recordings European Union / Malta Privacy Policy
Mailchimp (Intuit) Email marketing and newsletter subscription management United States Intuit Global Privacy Statement
Stripe Payment processing for invoices and transactions United States / Global Privacy Policy
Wave Invoicing and payment management Canada Privacy Policy

Questions

If you have questions about our subprocessors or how we handle your data, please contact us at hello@bluedroplabs.com.
